title: Polymarket Crypto and DeFi Markets
description: Tracks prediction markets related to cryptocurrency, blockchain, DeFi, and Web3. Monitor what the crowd thinks about Bitcoin price targets, ETF approvals, protocol upgrades, regulatory actions, and crypto market events. Cross-reference with actual crypto prices for edge detection.
code:
import pandas as pd
import requests
import json
import re
from datetime import datetime, timezone

BASE = 'https://gamma-api.polymarket.com'
LIMIT = 100
MAX_PAGES = 5

CRYPTO_KEYWORDS = re.compile(
    r'\b(bitcoin|btc|ethereum|eth|crypto|blockchain|defi|nft|web3|'
    r'solana|sol|cardano|ada|polkadot|dot|avalanche|avax|chainlink|'
    r'ripple|xrp|dogecoin|doge|shiba|pepe|memecoin|stablecoin|'
    r'usdt|usdc|tether|binance|coinbase|kraken|ftx|sec.crypto|'
    r'etf.bitcoin|etf.ethereum|halving|mining|staking|validator|'
    r'airdrop|token|altcoin|whale|rug.pull|smart.contract|'
    r'layer.2|rollup|zk|bridge|dao|yield|liquidity.pool|'
    r'\$[0-9]+k.*btc|btc.*\$[0-9]+k)\b',
    re.IGNORECASE
)

CRYPTO_TAGS = {'crypto', 'bitcoin', 'ethereum', 'defi', 'web3', 'nft',
               'blockchain', 'cryptocurrency', 'altcoins', 'stablecoins',
               'mining', 'trading'}

rows = []
for page in range(MAX_PAGES):
    offset = page * LIMIT
    resp = requests.get(
        f'{BASE}/markets',
        params={'limit': LIMIT, 'offset': offset, 'active': 'true', 'closed': 'false'},
        timeout=30,
    )
    resp.raise_for_status()
    markets = resp.json()
    if not markets:
        break
    for m in markets:
        question = m.get('question', '')
        desc = m.get('description', '')
        category = (m.get('category', '') or '').lower()
        tags_raw = m.get('tags', [])
        if isinstance(tags_raw, str):
            tags_raw = json.loads(tags_raw)
        tag_labels = []
        tag_slugs = set()
        for t in (tags_raw or []):
            if isinstance(t, dict):
                label = t.get('label', t.get('slug', ''))
                tag_labels.append(label)
                tag_slugs.add(label.lower())
                if t.get('slug'):
                    tag_slugs.add(t['slug'].lower())
            else:
                tag_labels.append(str(t))
                tag_slugs.add(str(t).lower())
        is_crypto = bool(CRYPTO_KEYWORDS.search(question) or CRYPTO_KEYWORDS.search(desc))
        is_crypto = is_crypto or bool(tag_slugs.intersection(CRYPTO_TAGS))
        is_crypto = is_crypto or 'crypto' in category
        if not is_crypto:
            continue
        prices = m.get('outcomePrices', '[]')
        if isinstance(prices, str):
            prices = json.loads(prices)
        yes_price = float(prices[0]) if prices else None
        no_price = float(prices[1]) if len(prices) > 1 else None
        rows.append({
            'market_id': m.get('id', ''),
            'question': question,
            'slug': m.get('slug', ''),
            'yes_price': yes_price,
            'no_price': no_price,
            'volume': float(m.get('volume', 0) or 0),
            'liquidity': float(m.get('liquidity', 0) or 0),
            'category': m.get('category', ''),
            'tags': ','.join(tag_labels),
            'end_date': m.get('endDate', ''),
            'condition_id': m.get('conditionId', ''),
            '_epoch': int(datetime.now(timezone.utc).timestamp()),
        })

df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
df = df.sort_values('volume', ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)
GENERATE_RESULTS(df)
